global_rules: Sequential only: python scripts/run_campaign.py <plan> (C10 plans refuse --workers != 1). Every launch counts, failed or not. Hard cap 200: config/solver.yaml max_launches 260 (= 60 used before C10 + 200) and a C10 label counter (c10_* run IDs in RUN_INDEX <= 200) in run_campaign.py.

run_campaign.py (C10 plans) never re-launches an entry whose label already has a RUN_INDEX row, from this or any other C10 plan (MIN10 vs stage plans): a successful earlier launch is reused, a failed one is reported; --retry ID spends a new (reserve) launch on purpose.
Model file for every entry: $env:IWO_MODEL_FILE = "config/iwo_material_model_v3.yaml" (V3 + the overrides = the same solver statements as V2 + the overrides, check_v3_equivalence.py).
After any code change: python analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/regress_all_decks.py must print "unexpected differences 0" before the next launch.

run_campaign.py records a failed launch and CONTINUES (this plan declares no gates); it stops automatically only at the launch budget / C10 cap. Every stop rule below is applied manually: the main session reads the state-only results/campaigns/<plan>.json (full record sealed under results/sealed/campaigns) and decides.

Invocation, pre-launch gate and --retry rule. First invocation: $env:IWO_MODEL_FILE = "config/iwo_material_model_v3.yaml"; <project venv python> scripts/run_campaign.py config/campaign_C10_DIAGb.json --retry S2-11   (FIRST invocation only, in PowerShell from the package root, immediately after the A41 pre-launch gate has exited 0 in the same session; any re-invocation uses the command the gate prints under the STARTED-row rule in stop_rules; IWO_ATLAS_VIEWERS unset = viewer policy record). Before EVERY invocation of this plan, the first one and any re-invocation (after an interruption, a crash, sleep or a declined hook), in the same PowerShell session and working directory as the invocation and immediately before it, the A41 pre-launch gate (prelaunch_gate_a41.py, run with python -I; sha256 recorded in A41) must exit 0 (Codex item 2); if it fails, nothing is invoked and the failure is reported. The gate asserts by explicit equality and fails on any mismatch: working directory = the package root; IWO_MODEL_FILE = config/iwo_material_model_v3.yaml; IWO_ATLAS_VIEWERS and IWO_ATLAS_JOB unset; the sha256 of this plan file, of every file in scripts/ (public-repo 1375164), of score_register.py and of regress_all_decks.py; the dry-built deck text and material text sha256 of both entries (next rule); no running deckbuild, dbascii, atlas, atlas2, atlas3, atlasM, atlasMc, tonyplot, tonyplot3d, athena, athena1d or devedit process and no python process whose command line names run_atlas or run_campaign (a runner crash can leave DeckBuild running, and a resume would then start the next entry beside it); the RUN_INDEX state below; every started A41 run listed in config/sealed_runs.json with its STARTED-row input columns as registered; the launch budget and the C10 cap. It prints the one command to use. --retry rule (unchanged; RUN_INDEX columns run_id and label only): pass --retry S2-11 if and only if no c10_s2_11_2p0 row with a run id above run_0075 exists; otherwise never pass it (a rerun start row counts as the one A41 rerun, finished or not; there is no third S2-11 launch), and never repeat the stored command verbatim once the rerun has a RUN_INDEX row. --retry S2-11 deliberately bypasses the C10 label-reuse rule for S2-11 only: run_0075 holds that label and its execution.json status is a runner success although it timed out, so without --retry run_campaign would reuse run_0075 for S2-11 and go on to S0-02-DOS2. S0-02-DOS2 is never relaunched (label rule). A DIAGb record of S2-11 as run_0075 "reused" is never the registered S2-11 result: it is reported and the --retry rule above is applied. The gate also stops for a main-session decision on a c10_s0_02_dos2_2p0 row without a rerun row (order not followed), on more than one rerun or S0-02-DOS2 run id, and on any other launch after run_0075 (expected ids shifted); once both A41 runs have started it reports that nothing remains to launch and exits non-zero.

Before the first invocation (main session, in the same PowerShell session and working directory as the launch, the package root): A41 logged together with the resolution-method sign-off (register and decision log) after Codex review; the user's go for THIS launch; the deck regression gate in its sealed-aware form, analysis_2026-10-10_campaign/regress_sealed_aware.py (the committed regress_all_decks.py, unchanged, over every run except the ids of the explicit sealed-run inventory config/sealed_runs.json, whose RUN_INDEX rows and run directories are not read, plus each sealed run's RUN_INDEX deck_sha256 and model_sha256 equal to the inventory and to the current rebuild of its matrix entry; A41 (e)) ending "unexpected differences 0"; make_campaign_configs.py --check YES; score_register.py sha256 c0f28bb942508a81a0f59b4a4c1e720bbfdbe8d9466d7e002476d64dcc10b55a with selftest 90/90; scripts/run_campaign.py, run_atlas.py, campaign_gates.py, campaign_sealed.py, proc_guard.py as committed in public-repo 1375164; and the pre-launch gate of the previous rule, which checks, with IWO_MODEL_FILE set as in the command, that run_campaign.current_deck_text gives deck text sha256 3034b7e276d40f8f8e3587219cbafe82c97c9db43ce23706938e18b4285ee956 (S2-11) and 09bb893d3254c9f0de24238e5b6f5eca3fa99c549c8d3f9456709eec95ff8e85 (S0-02-DOS2) and current_material_text sha256 974b23ea65ceaa38185221c1a62bb6f1b4eef54fd4884bb7eaadc38a83f18204 (= RUN_INDEX model_sha256 of run_0067) for both entries; results/campaigns/campaign_C10_DIAGb.json and results/sealed/campaigns/campaign_C10_DIAGb.full.json / .console.log absent.

State-only (Codex D7): the console and results/campaigns/campaign_C10_DIAGb.json carry state only; the full record and the launch output are sealed under results/sealed/campaigns. No current, metric or note of either run is opened, printed or scored before both launches have ended and the scoring order below starts. The only reads allowed before then are the input columns of each run's STARTED row in RUN_INDEX (run_id, label, deck_sha256, model_sha256 and the STARTED note, written at launch before any output): deck_sha256 must equal the deck hash above for its entry, model_sha256 974b23ea65ceaa38185221c1a62bb6f1b4eef54fd4884bb7eaadc38a83f18204, and the note must contain model=config/iwo_material_model_v3.yaml. Sealed-run inventory (Codex item 5): each run of this plan is appended to config/sealed_runs.json (run id, label, entry, the registered deck and model sha256 above, reason) as soon as its RUN_INDEX STARTED row exists, during or right after the invocation, and before any later regression check or re-invocation; regress_sealed_aware.py refuses to run while a RUN_INDEX run with a state-only plan label is missing from the inventory, and the pre-launch gate refuses a re-invocation while a started A41 run is missing. Removing an entry needs a logged decision. Viewer windows are not looked at; a viewer recorded by the process guard is disclosed.

Failures: run_campaign records a failed launch and continues (no gates). A failed, timed-out or invalid launch is reported and kept, never deleted, and not relaunched under A41. Validity is read from the RUN_INDEX exit_code of the run's finish row or from the frozen scorer's run_problems, never from the state file (its projection carries no timed_out or return code: a timed-out run with complete exports shows as completed with status REAL_ATLAS_SCORED, as run_0075 did). The viewer risk (policy record) applies to BOTH launches: a viewer holding DeckBuild makes the rerun time out at 5400 s (invalid; S2-11 UNRESOLVED, QTNLSC convergence not demonstrated) or S0-02-DOS2 time out at 3600 s (invalid; no I_G pair; S2-11 at best PROVISIONAL). With S2-11 first, the first real launch of runner 1375164 is the rerun itself: a runner defect that ends the invocation costs the one rerun (S2-11 UNRESOLVED). Any further launch needs a new logged amendment and the user's go.

Scoring after both launches (frozen score_register.py c0f28bb9), in this order: (1) runner state and run validity only; (2) resolution_pair <S0-02-DOS2 run> <run_0067> ig_raw_A -> PAIR.json; if the call raises (e.g. the frozen scorer's ZeroDivisionError when the only disagreeing points are exact zeros in both runs) or writes no JSON, there is no pair; (3) the registered S2-11 score: hc_mesh <S2-11 rerun> <run_0067> --resolution-ig <candidate_resolution_A_per_um of PAIR.json, verbatim; no larger value may be cited> --resolution-ig-source PAIR.json if the pair qualified, otherwise hc_mesh <S2-11 rerun> <run_0067> without --resolution-ig (PROVISIONAL). The sha256 of PAIR.json and of the score JSON go into the action note, with the candidate compared against the deck's ir.tol 1e-19 and cr.toler 1e-17 / 5e-18. A qualifying pair is a reproducibility floor under the DOS quadrature intervention (numa/numd are the energy-level intervals of the continuous-defect integral): it is neither Newton-controlled accuracy nor an absolute bound on the tunnelling discretization error. The registered S2-11 run is the rerun (pinned by A41; run_0075 is never substituted); its verdict carries the A41 disclosure label "S1-informed operational method; S2 blinding cannot be demonstrated; possibly exposed; not viewed according to the user's statement" (Codex item 6). The shared run_0067 baseline is recorded (resolution_pair_relation, independent false).

After this plan: campaign_C10_DIAGa_S2-11 is held (runnable=false, superseded by this plan); campaign_C10_DIAG stays held for its own conditions and, when launched, reuses S2-11 by label (the highest c10_s2_11_2p0 run id, the rerun). runs.label: c10_s2_11_2p0
runs.purpose: Numerics of the leakage result (register H-C, S2-11 redefined; first S2 launch): S0-02 (run_0067 form: QTNLSC worst set, automatic slicing, S/D exclude_near) with the device oxide y-mesh spacing halved at the oxide lines (Al2O3 line 0.25 -> 0.125 nm, HfO2 line 1.0 -> 0.5 nm); the y = 0 IWO/Al2O3 line (0.0625 nm, shared with the IWO interface mesh) is unchanged. Actual refinement (run_0067 equilibrium.str + geometric grading): Al2O3 15 -> about 22 intervals (largest 0.25 -> 0.125 nm, smallest 0.06 nm unchanged), HfO2 28 -> about 55, i.e. Al2O3 about x1.5 and HfO2 about x2. Timeout x4.5: run_0067 took 1246 s on 9594 nodes and 43 oxide intervals per slice; this deck has about 13.7k nodes and about 77 (run_0062, 13,689 nodes and 75, ran out of memory at the old 2 GB limit).
runs.pre_registered_expectation: resolved log10 |I_G| changes by <= 0.1 dec at every V_G vs S0-02 (run_0067); points below the demonstrated resolution are censored, never a pass (register section 0 and H-C; score_register.py hc_mesh)

runs.label: c10_s0_02_dos2_2p0
runs.purpose: Resolution refinement for S2-11 (register A41): S0-02 exactly as launched in run_0067 (QTNLSC worst set, automatic slicing, S/D exclude_near, oxide mesh unchanged) with the DOS quadrature doubled (numa/numd 384/192 -> 768/384, the S1-04 DOS x2 knob); nothing else changes. Its I_G comparison with run_0067 (score_register.py resolution_pair <this run> <run_0067> ig_raw_A) is the candidate I_G ceiling for hc_mesh <S2-11 rerun> <run_0067>; the shared run_0067 baseline is recorded as NOT independent. Numerical stability under the DOS intervention only, not an absolute error bound (ASSUMED operational method).
runs.pre_registered_expectation: no physics prediction (a numerical refinement): the pair qualifies only under the frozen support rule (>= 3 agreeing points above the candidate, one within 1 decade of it, full bias coverage, deck ratio tolerance 1e-3); a non-qualifying pair leaves S2-11 PROVISIONAL (register section 0 censoring; A41)
